response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced full-stack and web software engineer with strong TDD/testing practices and diverse language exposure, but his background is almost entirely in web/mobile/backend application development. He has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator architecture, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architectures, or deep-learning workload performance optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured senior/staff-level software engineering experience
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems work (Dlang, async I/O at Sociomantic)
Strong track record of technical leadership, teaching, and open-source contributions
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture background
No hardware-software co-design or chip design collaboration experience

key_factors.factor: No deep-learning or GPU workload optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and performance-oriented coding experience
